categories.main_business_segments: Tex Year Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of adhesives including hot melt adhesives, acrylic adhesives, UV adhesives, reactive polyurethane, and epoxy adhesives. The company also produces specialized chemicals, industrial automation machinery, dental materials, and filtration materials for various industries such as electronics, automotive, packaging, medical, and air purification. Additionally, it engages in import-export and agency services related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced adhesive technologies including hot melt adhesives with bio-based and biodegradable formulations, UV curing adhesives, and water-based pressure-sensitive adhesives. Production processes involve heating, mixing, cooling, grinding, defoaming, and packaging. Tex Year emphasizes green and sustainable manufacturing methods, energy-efficient processes, and automation to reduce costs and environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tex Year serves a diverse customer base across industries such as packaging, electronics, automotive, medical, furniture, and air filtration. Key markets include manufacturers of consumer goods, electronic components, automotive parts, medical devices, and filtration products. The company targets global niche markets with a focus on sustainable and high-performance adhesive solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production and R&D facilities in Taiwan, China (Guangzhou, Wuxi, Jiangsu), Vietnam, India, Poland, and the United States. Major sales markets include Asia (especially Greater China and ASEAN), Europe, and the Americas. Tex Year maintains localized operations to serve regional markets effectively and mitigate trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tex Year operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of adhesive products and specialty chemicals. It sources raw materials from upstream petrochemical suppliers and delivers finished adhesive solutions downstream to manufacturers and end-users across various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development through its Green Platform Strategy (GPS), focusing on green materials, carbon reduction, and circular economy solutions. R&D efforts target new products such as bio-based and biodegradable hot melt adhesives, environmentally friendly UV adhesives, and advanced filtration materials. Tex Year also emphasizes automation, energy efficiency, and expanding proprietary brands globally.
categories.revenue_model: Tex Year generates revenue mainly through product sales of adhesives, specialty chemicals, filtration materials, and related equipment. It also earns income from technical services, licensing, and agency sales. The company leverages global distribution networks and strategic partnerships to maximize market penetration and sales volume.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tex Year is a leading professional adhesive manufacturer in Taiwan with approximately 36% market share in hot melt adhesives domestically. It competes with both local and international adhesive producers by leveraging advanced technology, diversified product lines, and global manufacturing presence. The company positions itself as a high-value, sustainable adhesive solutions provider with strong R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Tex Year reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.68 billion, an 11% increase from the previous year, with net profit rising significantly by 169%. The company maintains a healthy financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 43.89% and strong liquidity ratios. It has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and shareholder returns, supported by expanding global operations and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tex Year differentiates itself through its commitment to green and sustainable adhesive technologies, offering bio-based, biodegradable, and low-VOC products that meet stringent environmental regulations. Its global localized production and R&D network enable rapid response to customer needs and market trends. The company emphasizes total solutions, high product performance, and strong customer service to create value and maintain competitive advantage.
